model_family: scalar seasonal ARX approximation of the paper RC state equation
interpretation: The control regressor is whole-building facility electricity, not HVAC thermal power. These observational EnergyPlus ARX models may screen candidate schedules, but EnergyPlus remains the comfort oracle and pandapower remains the grid oracle.
forbidden_claims: Do not describe the observational electricity coefficient as a measured thermal response.
Do not use one-step fit quality as proof that a multi-step dispatch is physically feasible.
Do not publish an optimized schedule until the EnergyPlus-pandapower validation chain passes.
